project.name: BRIDGE — Data Modeling Team
project.mission: Produce well-modeled parquet / Iceberg files for the project's targeted data resources, each backed by a shared LinkML schema.
what_is_it: BRIDGE is a U.S. Dept. of Energy (Biological & Environmental Research) effort to build a federated, AI-ready data ecosystem for bioscience — an "American Science Cloud" for biology. Its central idea is a closed loop between automated/robotic experiments and AI models: because biology has few first-principles models, the project leans heavily on experiments both to generate data and to keep AI predictions honest.

Three lead laboratories drive it: Argonne (transforming protein engineering — this IDEAS dataset is Argonne's contribution), Berkeley + PNNL (microbial functions for bio-based manufacturing), and Oak Ridge (bio-design for critical-material supply), with Livermore and Los Alamos joining as it grows.

The Data Modeling (DM) Team — whose meeting notes this summary is drawn from — is the sub-team that makes each lab's data usable together: give every dataset a schema (in LinkML), register it, harmonize the schemas toward a shared core, and ETL the data into a shared lakehouse as parquet / Iceberg tables.
goals: Schema development — every dataset that is ingested must have a LinkML schema.
Schema registry — every schema goes into the shared registry (ber-data/lakehouse-registry).
Schema harmonization — converge on a small, shared "bridge-central-schema".
Schema workshopping — recurring hackathons that model one data type at a time.
Data in the lakehouse — deliver each resource as query-ready parquet / Iceberg.
Persistent, resolvable identifiers (PIDs) for every entity, using CURIEs / Bioregistry prefixes and, ideally, a central ID resolver.
base_classes: The physical or biological things studied.
What was measured about a sample — modeled as attribute/value/unit collections plus measurement events.
The reactions / procedures that act on samples.
Reusable catalog entities referenced by samples and measurements.
Flat join tables linking samples to entities and processes.
Links out to authoritative external databases.
progress: The IDEAS (Argonne protein-engineering) dataset shown here has been delivered as a typed Apache Iceberg warehouse (v2) with full snapshot history — the "example data + schema" deliverable in a real open-table format.
Other resources are moving in parallel: the BASALT schema is finished and MONet data is loaded into Iceberg; AMP2 is in progress.
LinkML lunch-and-learn training (project setup, the modeling language, validation & serialization) has been delivered to the team.

The team settled on DuckDB as the practical bridge between LinkML and parquet/Iceberg, and on a small flat base model — Samples, Measurements/Observations, Processes, Datasets — that each resource specializes via LinkML "implements / instantiates".
immediate: Oct 1, 2026 milestone: every resource provides example data + a schema.
The first modeling hackathon (weekly, starting Sep 30, 2026) is focused on Measurements / Observations — exactly the part of this dataset highlighted on the Measurements page.
Build a top-down central model + visualization, and demonstrate AI-assisted verification of schema transformations.
Firm up the attribute/value pattern for measurements, require units to carry ontology terms (UO / UCUM), and require provenance (data steward) on records.
how_ideas_fits: This IDEAS tetrad dataset is a near-perfect instance of the BRIDGE base model: idea_sample = Samples; idea_measurement + sample_parameter = Measurements/Observations (as attribute/value/unit); idea_reaction + idea_stoichiometry = Processes; idea_protein + idea_reactant = reference entities; the sample_* tables are the flat Association/join tables; and idea_dbxref supplies the resolvable cross-reference PIDs.
Identifiers already follow the CURIE convention the team wants (e.g. SMP:1, EXP:tetrad-synthesis), and every row carries provenance (created_by / created_at / updated_at).
project.source: BRIDGE Data Modeling Team — weekly meeting notes (Apr–Sep 2026).

releases.audit_note: tetrad_v1 also added provenance columns (created_at, updated_at, created_by) to every shared table, and typed all columns (int / real / date / boolean / timestamp) — the earlier release stored everything as text.

essential_missing.why: The computational/structural metrics — ESM-1v fitness, AlphaFold pLDDT, MD RMSD, relative abundances, fold-change to WT — that link AI predictions to lab results. Central to the AI↔experiment loop BRIDGE is built around.

temperature, pH, buffer & buffer_concentration, ATP/MgCl2, incubation time, shaking rpm, lysate/total volumes — the assay set-up. Without them a measured titer/conversion cannot be reproduced or compared across samples. The Measurements hackathon needs method+conditions.
The engineered protein variants themselves (mutation lists). sample_protein.idea_mutant_id still points at them, so in tetrad_v1 those references are unresolvable.
The AI design proposals (models, proposed mutations, Pareto scores) — the 'AI' half of the AI-guided design story.
The compute jobs (AlphaFold, ESM-1v, MD) that produced the protein metrics — provenance for the computed values.
The wet/dry-lab methods and their executions. tetrad_v1 dropped procedure_id from several tables, severing samples/measurements from their method.
Who did the work, where, and in which host strain — provenance/agent and biological-source context.
Links out to KBase/ModelSEED entities — external identifiers useful for harmonization.

summary: tetrad_v1 has 12 tables; the earlier release had 21. 9 tables were dropped: ai_design, computation, idea_lab, idea_mutant, idea_people, idea_procedure, idea_protocol, idea_strain, protein_parameter.
Row totals: earlier 715 rows, tetrad_v1 3247 rows (tetrad_v1 grew the surviving assay tables but lost whole categories of data).

tetrad_v1 gained real types, provenance columns and the actual assay readouts (titer, conversion, mass-spec intensity); it lost the reaction conditions, the computed protein metrics (protein_parameter) and the design / compute / method / people tables.
This portal shows the UNION: the earlier tables and measurements are restored and every table / column / parameter is flagged by which release it came from.

hackathon.title: First BRIDGE modeling hackathon — Measurements / Observations
hackathon.when: Weekly on Wednesdays, starting Sep 30 2026 (11:00–13:30 PT / 14:00–16:30 ET).
hackathon.focus: Model the Measurements/Observations data type into a reusable LinkML component in the shared bridge-common-schema.
pattern: Sample → Observation Unit → Measurement: a sample is observed, and each observation produces one or more measured values.
Each measurement is an attribute + value + unit triple (the EAV pattern) — and the unit should carry an ontology term (UCUM / UO / BERVO).
Measurement + unit + method are often grouped together, because the same quantity can differ only by how it was produced (the instrument / method).
homework: Describe the measurement data you are bringing (types, units, methods).
Map your measurements onto the shared base Measurement class.
Bring example data + a LinkML schema (the Oct 1 2026 milestone).
Flag units that need ontology terms and identifiers that need CURIEs.
hackathon.how_this_dataset_helps: This portal already exposes IDEAS measurements in exactly this shape: idea_measurement = observation events, sample_parameter / protein_parameter = attribute/value/unit measured values, each unit UCUM-coded — a ready worked example for the workshop.

rules.rule: Every ingested dataset has a LinkML schema
rules.how_ideas_meets: This schema (ideas.linkml.yaml) is generated for the full merged IDEAS dataset and is downloadable from this page.

rules.rule: Specialize a small shared base model (Samples, Measurements/Observations, Processes, Datasets)
rules.how_ideas_meets: Each table declares the BRIDGE base class it instantiates via a class_uri / is_a mapping — see the class map below.

rules.rule: Model measurements as attribute / value / unit (EAV)
rules.how_ideas_meets: sample_parameter and protein_parameter are MeasurementValue classes with label (attribute), value and unit slots — the exact pattern the first hackathon targets.

rules.rule: Units must carry ontology terms (UCUM / UO)
rules.how_ideas_meets: Every unit slot is annotated with its UCUM code (e.g. mg/L → mg/L, mM → mmol/L, ångström → Ao); see the unit table.

rules.rule: Persistent, resolvable identifiers as CURIEs (bioregistry prefixes)
rules.how_ideas_meets: id slots are identifiers with id_prefixes (SMP, EXP, PROT, RXN, RCT) and the prefixes block maps each to a resolvable w3id / bioregistry base URI.
A ProvenanceMixin (created_at, updated_at, created_by) is mixed into the tetrad_v1 classes; cross-references (idea_dbxref) resolve entities to external PIDs.

rules.rule: Register the schema in the shared registry
rules.how_ideas_meets: Target: github.com/ber-data/lakehouse-registry — the generated YAML is registry-ready.

linkml.yaml:
id: https://w3id.org/ideas/ideas-schema
name: ideas_schema
title: "IDEAS enzyme-engineering dataset (BRIDGE)"
description: "Auto-generated LinkML schema for the merged IDEAS dataset (Argonne's BRIDGE contribution). Each class specializes a shared BRIDGE base class; measurements use the attribute/value/unit pattern with UCUM-coded units; identifiers are CURIEs; provenance is captured via a ProvenanceMixin."
license: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
default_prefix: ideas
default_range: string
prefixes:
  linkml: "https://w3id.org/linkml/"
  ideas: "https://w3id.org/ideas/"
  SMP: "https://w3id.org/ideas/sample/"
  EXP: "https://w3id.org/ideas/experiment/"
  PROT: "https://w3id.org/ideas/protein/"
  RXN: "https://w3id.org/ideas/reaction/"
  RCT: "https://w3id.org/ideas/reactant/"
  UO: "http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UO_"
  UCUM: "https://ucum.org/"
  CHEBI: "http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_"
  uniprot: "https://bioregistry.io/uniprot:"
  pdb: "https://bioregistry.io/pdb:"
  pubchem.compound: "https://bioregistry.io/pubchem.compound:"
imports:
  - linkml:types
classes:
  ProvenanceMixin:
    mixin: true
    description: "Provenance fields required on ingested records."
    slots: [created_at, updated_at, created_by]
  Sample:
    abstract: true
    description: "A physical or biological thing that is studied and measured."
  Observation:
    abstract: true
    description: "A measurement EVENT on a sample (an assay run / instrument reading)."
  MeasurementValue:
    abstract: true
    description: "One measured number, modeled as attribute + value + unit (EAV)."
  Process:
    abstract: true
    description: "An activity that acts on samples/entities (reaction, procedure, computation, design)."
  ReferenceEntity:
    abstract: true
    description: "A reusable catalog entity referenced by samples and measurements (protein, reactant, variant)."
  Association:
    abstract: true
    description: "A flat join linking a sample to an entity or process."
  CrossReference:
    abstract: true
    description: "A resolvable link out to an authoritative external database (a PID bridge)."
  Investigation:
    abstract: true
    description: "The overarching study/campaign that groups samples."
  Agent:
    abstract: true
    description: "A person or organization that performed or is responsible for something."
  ai_design:
    description: "AI-guided design proposals — the method / model, the proposed mutations and sequence, optimization targets and multi-objective (Pareto) scores, and whether the candidate was picked for testing. (Dropped in tetrad_v1.)"
    is_a: Process
    class_uri: ideas:ai_design
    slots: [id, idea_protein_id, design_method, model_name, proposed_mutations, proposed_sequence, optimization_target, optimization_algorithm, generation, objective_scores, pareto_rank, pareto_optimal, selected_for_testing, design_rationale, run_date, notes]
  computation:
    description: "Computational jobs run on a protein / variant / reaction — structure prediction, ML scoring or MD simulation — with model name, compute platform, parameters and the output file. (Dropped in tetrad_v1.)"
    is_a: Process
    class_uri: ideas:computation
    slots: [id, idea_protein_id, idea_mutant_id, idea_reaction_id, procedure_id, type, model_name, compute_platform, simulation_params, run_date, filename, notes]
  idea_dbxref:
    description: "Links every IDEAS entity out to an authoritative external database (UniProt, PDB, PubChem, …) via a database name + accession + resolvable URL. The dataset's persistent-identifier bridge."
    is_a: CrossReference
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:idea_dbxref
    slots: [id, entity_type, entity_id, database_name, accession, url]
  idea_experiment:
    description: "The study (investigation) that produced the samples — here the tetrad oligoamide-synthesis campaign. One row per experiment."
    is_a: Investigation
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:idea_experiment
    slots: [id, start_date, type, index_num, description, procedure_id]
  idea_lab:
    description: "The laboratories participating in the campaign (name + location). (Dropped in tetrad_v1.)"
    is_a: Agent
    class_uri: ideas:idea_lab
    slots: [id, name, location]
  idea_measurement:
    description: "One row per measurement event on a sample (e.g. a mass-spec or LC-MS run), with the assay type and the source data file. The individual numbers produced live in sample_parameter."
    is_a: Observation
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:idea_measurement
    slots: [id, sample_id, type, filename, notes, procedure_id]
  idea_mutant:
    description: "Engineered protein variants — the mutation list applied to a parent protein, its (optional) sequence, how it was designed and a link to the AI design that proposed it. (Dropped in tetrad_v1.)"
    is_a: ReferenceEntity
    class_uri: ideas:idea_mutant
    slots: [id, idea_protein_id, mutations, aa_sequence, dna_sequence, design_method, ai_design_id, notes]
  idea_people:
    description: "People (contacts) associated with the labs and procedures. (Dropped in tetrad_v1.)"
    is_a: Agent
    class_uri: ideas:idea_people
    slots: [id, first_name, last_name, email, lab_id]
  idea_procedure:
    description: "A concrete execution of a protocol in a lab by a contact person on a date — the wet/dry-lab procedure record referenced by samples and measurements. (Dropped in tetrad_v1.)"
    is_a: Process
    class_uri: ideas:idea_procedure
    slots: [id, protocol_id, lab_id, contact_id, timestamp]
  idea_protein:
    description: "The enzymes (and engineered variants) studied — amino-acid and DNA sequence, source organism, and a link to a predicted/known structure."
    is_a: ReferenceEntity
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:idea_protein
    slots: [id, name, aa_sequence, dna_sequence, structure_url, source_organism, source_type, notes, kb_protein_id, kb_genome_id]
  idea_protocol:
    description: "Reusable protocol definitions (a method description + an attached file) that procedures instantiate. (Dropped in tetrad_v1.)"
    is_a: Process
    class_uri: ideas:idea_protocol
    slots: [id, description, filename]
  idea_reactant:
    description: "The chemical species — substrates, cofactors and synthesized products — with structure notations (SMILES / InChI / InChIKey), molecular formula and weight."
    is_a: ReferenceEntity
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:idea_reactant
    slots: [id, name, aliases, smiles, inchi, inchi_key, molecular_formula, molecular_weight, notes, kb_metabolite_id]
  idea_reaction:
    description: "The chemical reactions studied, with a human equation and a machine SMARTS reaction pattern."
    is_a: Process
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:idea_reaction
    slots: [id, name, equation, smarts, reaction_type, notes, kb_reaction_id]
  idea_sample:
    description: "Every assay sample / replicate. The hub of the schema: each sample belongs to an experiment and a strain and is the thing that gets measured, has proteins expressed in it, and has substrates and reactions attached."
    is_a: Sample
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:idea_sample
    slots: [id, name, experiment_id, strain_id, replicate, sample_type, parent_sample_id, storage_location, notes, procedure_id]
  idea_stoichiometry:
    description: "Which reactants take part in which reaction and in what role (substrate / product) and coefficient — the reaction↔reactant membership table."
    is_a: Association
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:idea_stoichiometry
    slots: [id, idea_reaction_id, idea_reactant_id, coefficient, role, notes]
  idea_strain:
    description: "Host strains the samples were grown from (e.g. E. coli BL21(DE3)), with a parent-strain self-reference. (Dropped in tetrad_v1.)"
    is_a: Sample
    class_uri: ideas:idea_strain
    slots: [id, long_name, short_name, parent_strain_id]
  protein_parameter:
    description: "Computed / structural metrics for a protein or engineered variant — attribute/value/unit rows for ESM-1v scores, AlphaFold pLDDT, MD RMSD, relative abundances and fold-change to wild type. The computational counterpart of sample_parameter (dropped in tetrad_v1)."
    is_a: MeasurementValue
    class_uri: ideas:protein_parameter
    slots: [id, idea_protein_id, idea_mutant_id, label, value, unit, error, measurement_id, computation_id, idea_reaction_id, notes]
  sample_parameter:
    description: "The core measured-value table, stored as attribute/value/unit triples: each row is one measured number for one sample (optionally scoped to a reactant and/or reaction) — titer, conversion, mass-spec intensity, …"
    is_a: MeasurementValue
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:sample_parameter
    slots: [id, sample_id, idea_reactant_id, idea_reaction_id, label, value, value_type, unit]
  sample_protein:
    description: "Which protein (and, where relevant, which engineered variant) is present in each sample — the sample↔protein junction."
    is_a: Association
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:sample_protein
    slots: [id, sample_id, idea_protein_id, idea_mutant_id]
  sample_reactant:
    description: "Which reactants were added to each sample and at what concentration — the sample↔reactant junction, carrying a typed concentration + unit."
    is_a: Association
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:sample_reactant
    slots: [id, sample_id, idea_reactant_id, concentration, concentration_unit]
  sample_reaction:
    description: "Which reaction(s) each sample is running, flagging the primary one — the sample↔reaction junction."
    is_a: Association
    mixins: [ProvenanceMixin]
    class_uri: ideas:sample_reaction
    slots: [id, sample_id, idea_reaction_id, is_primary]

iceberg.note: Each tetrad_v1 table is an Iceberg table with data/*.parquet and metadata/ (metadata.json, manifest & snapshot .avro). Only the current snapshot is loaded. Earlier-release tables are plain parquet (not shown here).

eav_parameters.label: mass-spec intensity
eav_parameters.meaning: Raw mass-spectrometry peak intensity (arbitrary units) for an analyte.

eav_parameters.label: titer
eav_parameters.meaning: How much product the reaction made, as a concentration (mg per litre).

eav_parameters.label: conversion
eav_parameters.meaning: Fraction of substrate turned into product, in percent.

eav_parameters.label: nylon_type
eav_parameters.meaning: Nylon substrate type used.

eav_parameters.label: buffer_concentration_mM
eav_parameters.meaning: Buffer concentration in the reaction (millimolar).

eav_parameters.label: pH
eav_parameters.meaning: pH of the reaction mixture.

eav_parameters.label: shaking_rpm
eav_parameters.meaning: Shaking speed during incubation (rpm).

eav_parameters.label: lysate_volume_uL
eav_parameters.meaning: Cell-lysate volume added (microlitres).

eav_parameters.label: buffer
eav_parameters.meaning: Which buffer system was used.

eav_parameters.label: ATP_mM
eav_parameters.meaning: ATP cofactor concentration in the reaction (millimolar).

eav_parameters.label: project
eav_parameters.meaning: Project/campaign label carried on the sample.

eav_parameters.label: MgCl2_mM
eav_parameters.meaning: Magnesium chloride concentration in the reaction (millimolar).

eav_parameters.label: temperature_C
eav_parameters.meaning: Incubation temperature (degrees Celsius).

eav_parameters.label: incubation_time_h
eav_parameters.meaning: How long the reaction was incubated (hours).

eav_parameters.label: well_position
eav_parameters.meaning: Plate well the sample sat in.

eav_parameters.label: total_volume_uL
eav_parameters.meaning: Total reaction volume (microlitres).

eav_parameters.label: foldchange_to_WT
eav_parameters.meaning: Activity fold-change of a variant relative to wild type.

eav_parameters.label: N66_L2_abundance
eav_parameters.meaning: Relative abundance of the N66 L2 species (proteomics ratio).

eav_parameters.label: N66_L1_abundance
eav_parameters.meaning: Relative abundance of the N66 L1 species (proteomics ratio).

eav_parameters.label: esm1v_score
eav_parameters.meaning: ESM-1v zero-shot log-likelihood ratio — a language-model estimate of how tolerated a mutation is (higher = more favourable).

eav_parameters.label: RMSD_equilibrium
eav_parameters.meaning: Root-mean-square deviation at MD equilibrium (ångström) — how much the structure drifts; lower = more stable.

eav_parameters.label: pLDDT
eav_parameters.meaning: AlphaFold per-residue confidence score (0–100) for the predicted structure.
